mechanism: Sodium valproate may increase ethinyl estradiol levels through inhibition of glucuronidation and other metabolic pathways, while ethinyl estradiol may increase valproate levels by displacing protein binding, creating a bidirectional interaction.
action: Monitor for increased estrogenic side effects and valproate toxicity; consider alternative anticonvulsant or use lowest effective oral contraceptive dose with clinical monitoring of both drug efficacy and adverse effects.
